Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup. EDIT THE ATTACHED REFERENCE SCREENSHOT into an original-brand version. The user REJECTED previous redesigns because they drifted from this reference. Treat this as a precise UI skin adaptation, not an open-ended design exercise. Preserve the source screenshot's canvas aspect, exact header height, left sidebar width, all grid positions, card sizes, typography SCALE, row spacing, alignment, information density, content hierarchy and control placement. Preserve the exact store-selection task and screen state. It must look as polished, crisp and realistic as the source. Do not add any section, banner, hero image, basket sidebar, stepper, marketing story, footer, gradient, grain, texture or serif text.
Allowed changes only: replace Instacart wordmark/carrot with original 'fieldwork' lowercase wordmark in a confident contemporary geometric UI sans plus tiny original four-square mark. Brand accent cobalt #3557D8 replaces the branded greens in nav/login/wordmark. White canvas #FFFFFF, very light neutral gray header, neutral charcoal text. Use own consistent Inter-like UI typography, modest 20px section headings and normal 14–16px labels, not giant type. Replace retailer logos with ORIGINAL clean professional fictional-store logos in the same positions: Market Co., Greenlane, Daybreak, Corner Shop, Well & Co., Daily. Retailer cards preserve the exact visual density: small logo, store name, delivery ETA, pickup line, category line and one short benefit line. Text can be shortened slightly for clarity but cannot move into a different composition. Remove only the over-highlighted yellow marker backgrounds on benefit labels, make them small muted blue text. Top search says 'Search products, stores, and recipes'; cart stays 0. Keep 'Your stores', 'Beyond grocery', 'Popular stores near you' and the same positions. The output should be immediately recognizable as the exact reference pattern with a new original brand and own content, NOT a marketing concept. Pixel-sharp flat digital interface. No extra labels outside the screen.
